system.description:
• Effect: Your out-of-turn tricks, Parry, Riposte, and later additions, all draw from the same well.
  • Once per round, out of turn, perform one Flourish Manoeuvre from those currently known.
  • Using one manoeuvre in a round means none of the others are available until the next round.
  • You can't use them while wearing medium or heavy armour or while carrying a shield.
  • Known at 1st level: Parry and Riposte.
  • Parry: when struck in melee, make a Dexterity check (d20 + Dexterity modifier) against the attacker's attack roll. If it meets or beats the roll, negate the hit entirely.
  • Riposte: when an enemy misses you with a melee attack, make one melee attack against it if it is within your reach. This is your Flourish Manoeuvre; it is not an extra attack.

activities.name: Parry
activities.text: Against the attacker's attack roll; on success negate the hit.

activities.name: Riposte
activities.text: When an enemy misses you with a melee attack, a free attack against it as your Flourish for the round.

activities.name: Acrobatic Escape
activities.text: When an attack hits you (your Flourish for the round): halve its damage and move up to 10ft without provoking Attacks of Opportunity. No check.
